binary_activity.interpretation: Native scores are binary. Compare three-trial activity incidence per scene; do not apply a fractional range ceiling to individual binary classifications. This is not a confidence test.

cuda_pixels.reason: All reference-only PSNR holdouts pass3dB; one reference-only SSIM holdout exceeds0.03.

candidate_budget_calibration.npu: Unchanged; requires independent NPU reference-only calibration.
candidate_budget_calibration.rule: For a failed budget, multiply maximum reference-only deficit by1.25 and round upward (native scores0.005,SSIM0.005). Retain budgets whose held-out references already pass. This is not a confidence interval.
candidate_budget_calibration.scope: Reference-only cross-cohort holdouts. Candidate videos and scores excluded. Existing budgets change only when held-out same-code references exceed them. Preliminary until fresh target-head validation.

pending_validation: fresh final-head CUDA nightly and all weekly/long target profiles
NPU reference calibration on its own platform; no CUDA override applied
continuous_reference_calibration.rule: For each continuous dimension, take the maximum six-reference range across scenes, multiply by1.25, round upward to0.005, and retain the larger existing ceiling. This calculation does not set candidate or pixel budgets; their independent reference-only holdout calibration is recorded separately.
continuous_reference_calibration.scope: Reference-only preliminary CUDA nightly ceilings; no candidate scores used. Not a confidence interval. Other CUDA profiles and target H100 WBench scoring need held-out validation. NPU keeps separate existing ceilings until its own calibration. The older WBench reference cohort reserved four H100 slots, while the newer cohort reserved all eight and exposed four; this preliminary reference ceiling is not evidence of final isolated-run acceptance.

p95_reference_cv_calibration.rule: Maximum training-case P95 population CV across three independent starts, plus25% reserve, rounded up to0.005. Mean/P50 reference CV and candidate regression fractions stay unchanged.
p95_reference_cv_calibration.scope: H100 P95 reference-CV ceiling only: fit earlier frozen-reference weekly cohort, validate on all18 newer weekly cases plus independent nightly and long references. Candidate measurements excluded. Historical engine environment overrides were not recorded; fresh pinned final-source validation remains mandatory.

scope: Reference-only CUDA performance/quality calibration evidence, including target-H100 holdouts. Historical environment overrides were not retained; final-source acceptance and NPU calibration remain separate.

startup_stall_calibration.rule: Maximum held-out reference startup stall minus its calibration cohort maximum, over both cohort directions and all scenes; add25%reserve and round up to1ms. Apply as a floor only to total-stall allowance and also gate post-startup stalls independently, with no floor. Startup is max(2,warmup_chunks) media blocks.
startup_stall_calibration.scope: CUDA-only reference-only startup playback noise. Candidate observations excluded. NPU keeps zero floor until its own calibration. Fresh target validation remains required.

target_h100_hps_reference_calibration.scope: Reference-only target-H100 nightly HPSv3 calibration. Candidate scores excluded; fresh independent target-runner validation and all weekly/long profiles remain required.

target_h100_long_imaging_reference_calib.pending_validation: Independent target-H100 long reference starts at the final published source.
target_h100_long_imaging_reference_calib.scope: Frozen-reference H100 600-chunk WBench imaging calibration only; candidate scores are excluded. Current independent long campaign remains the holdout. This does not establish final-head acceptance.

ttfc_calibration.rule: Maximum positive held-out reference TTFC minus the training-cohort maximum, across matching cases in both directions; add25% reserve and round up to5ms.
ttfc_calibration.scope: H100 TTFC floor fitted to two nightly frozen-reference cohorts only; validated on two separate weekly cohorts. Candidate inputs excluded. Does not accept final-head candidate performance.

wbench_reference_cohorts.scope: H100-generated videos; independently scored with pinned WBench on L20X; target-H100 scoring validation remains pending
